text.content:
Built the CitiNet on rotten wire. Bankrupt since 2051.

Headquarters: Ziggurat HQ in Upper Marina, now Japantown (#59); Night Corp's since 2051
Industry: Networks and media (defunct)
Status: Lost the CitiNet in 2049; dissolved in bankruptcy in 2051

In the 2040s the Council wanted a CitiNet, one network for the whole city sealed off from the Old NET behind the Blackwall, like every other rebuilt city. Ziggurat won the contract with a bid nobody could touch and switched the CitiNet on in 2045, two years early. The bid was cheap because Ziggurat never laid most of the line: it patched the network into the city's armored pre-war Old NET trunks and ran everything from one main server terminal in the basement of its headquarters. It had wired other cities the same way and linked them all together.

On Static Night, 8 September 2047, that rotten wire nearly let the RABIDs back in. Every netrunner jacked into the Ziggurat network died in the Flicker, and the cult of Roxanne flooded Upper Marina to reach the main server terminal. Ziggurat blamed sabotage.

It lost the CitiNet contract in 2049 and two-thirds of its value within the year, and it was dissolved in bankruptcy in 2051. Night Corp bought the tower and runs the CitiNet from it; NetWatch took the top floors and holds the lease on the sealed sub-basements. Ziggurat's old plaque about the CitiNet is still in the lobby.

GM secrets

Hoshi Tanabe, Ziggurat's last head of PR, writes Night Corp press releases in the same building and broadcasts on Samizdat in secret. She knows which Ziggurat records survived the bankruptcy, and where they went.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.12; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 06, 09
